title: Archer pawn: the Arisen gets his own lock-on (0.9.168)
intro: Release the pawn, Reset Scripts, then take over the second Archer pawn again. No R1 in this test. Two weak goblins that can't die will appear in front of you. Press End (or click both sticks) to start.

steps.text: PART A: shoot from the hip (normal arrows + Spiral Arrow / Heavenly Shot) at the LEFT goblin. Turn the camera to it.
PART B: now the RIGHT goblin, same way. Watch what the Arisen is shooting or hitting too.
Done (goblins removed). Tell Claude: did your shots stay on the goblin you picked? Did the Arisen still fight?

probes.up: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ch=d and d.state and d.state.pawn_chara; if not ch then return '-' end; local fsm=ch:call('get_ActionManager'):get_field('Fsm'); return (tostring(fsm:call('getCurrentNodeName(System.UInt32)',1)):gsub('^Combat%.',''):gsub('Job02_SkillAttack%.',''))
probes.face: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ch=d and d.state and d.state.pawn_chara; if not ch then return '-' end; local tr=ch:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'); local p=tr:call('get_Position'); local function yaw(x,z) return math.floor(math.deg(math.atan(x,z))+0.5) end; local f=tr:call('get_WorldMatrix')[2]; return yaw(f.x,f.z)
probes.camyaw: local function yaw(x,z) return math.floor(math.deg(math.atan(x,z))+0.5) end; local f=sdk.get_primary_camera():call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'):call('get_WorldMatrix')[2]; return yaw(-f.x,-f.z)
probes.aimchr: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ch=d and d.state and d.state.pawn_chara; if not ch then return '-' end; local c=ch:call('get_AimCharacter'); if not c then return '-' end; return tostring(c:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Name'))
probes.aimchr_yaw: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ch=d and d.state and d.state.pawn_chara; if not ch then return '-' end; local tr=ch:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'); local p=tr:call('get_Position'); local function yaw(x,z) return math.floor(math.deg(math.atan(x,z))+0.5) end; local c=ch:call('get_AimCharacter'); if not c then return '-' end; local q=c:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); return yaw(q.x-p.x,q.z-p.z)
probes.aimpos_yaw: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ch=d and d.state and d.state.pawn_chara; if not ch then return '-' end; local tr=ch:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'); local p=tr:call('get_Position'); local function yaw(x,z) return math.floor(math.deg(math.atan(x,z))+0.5) end; local v=ch:call('get_AimTargetPosition'); if not v or v:read_byte(0)==0 then return '-' end; local x,y,z=v:read_float(16),v:read_float(20),v:read_float(24); return yaw(x-p.x,z-p.z)..'/'..math.floor(math.sqrt((x-p.x)^2+(z-p.z)^2)+0.5)..'m/dy'..math.floor(y-p.y+0.5)
probes.aimfront: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ch=d and d.state and d.state.pawn_chara; if not ch then return '-' end; local v=ch:call('get_AimTargetFrontAngleDeg'); if not v or v:read_byte(0)==0 then return '-' end; return math.floor(v:read_float(4)+0.5)
probes.shot: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ch=d and d.state and d.state.pawn_chara; if not ch then return '-' end; local n=tostring(ch:call('get_ActionManager'):get_field('Fsm'):call('getCurrentNodeName(System.UInt32)',1)); return n:find('Shoot',1,true)~=nil or n:find('Release',1,true)~=nil
probes.bmode: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local b=d and d.brain; if not b then return '-' end; return tostring(b.mode)
probes.sets: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local b=d and d.brain; return b and (b.lock_sets or 0) or -1
probes.ltgt: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local b=d and d.brain; if not b then return '-' end; local lk=b.lock; if not lk then return '-' end; local t=lk:call('get_Target'); if not t then return 'none' end; local c; pcall(function() c=t:get_field('Chara') or t:call('get_Chara') end); if c then return tostring(c:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Name')) end; return 'set'
probes.lchara: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local b=d and d.brain; if not b then return '-' end; local lk=b.lock; if not lk then return '-' end; local c=lk:get_field('Chara'); return c and tostring(c:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Name')) or '-'
probes.btgt: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local b=d and d.brain; if not b then return '-' end; local t=b.target; if not t then return '-' end; return tostring(t:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Name'))
probes.ar_yaw: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ch=d and d.state and d.state.pawn_chara; local ar=d and d.state and d.state.arisen_chara; if not (ch and ar) then return '-' end; local p=ch:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local q=ar:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); return math.floor(math.deg(math.atan(q.x-p.x,q.z-p.z))+0.5)..'/'..math.floor(math.sqrt((q.x-p.x)^2+(q.z-p.z)^2)+0.5)..'m'
probes.ar_aimchr: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ar=d and d.state and d.state.arisen_chara; if not ar then return '-' end; local c=ar:call('get_AimCharacter'); return c and tostring(c:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Name')) or '-'
probes.own: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local R=d and d.R; if not R then return '-' end; return R.ar_lock and true or false
probes.own_tgt: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local R=d and d.R; if not R then return '-' end; local lk=R.ar_lock; if not lk then return '-' end; local t=lk:call('get_Target'); if not t then return 'none' end; local c; pcall(function() c=t:get_field('Chara') or t:call('get_Chara') end); if c then return tostring(c:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_Name')) end; return 'set'
probes.own_info: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local R=d and d.R; if not R then return '-' end; return (R.ar_lock_made or 0)..'/'..(R.ar_lock_removed or 0)..'/'..(R.ar_lock_resets or 0)..(R.ar_lock_failed and 'F' or '')
probes.ar_hp: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ar=d and d.state and d.state.arisen_chara; if not ar then return '-' end; return tostring(ar:call('get_Hit'):call('get_HP'))
